fieldValues.title: Guard the PR classification line: Mode/Cell/Door vs the closed vocabularies
fieldValues.summary: check-pr-classification.mjs (ci-only, cell conformance) resolves a PR body's last Mode/Cell/Door line against decision-modes.json and pattern-grid-cells.json (glyph, name, or both), and checks a gate:auto-merge label against the autonomy contract. Wired into validate.yml as a pull_request-only job reading PR_BODY/PR_LABELS via env. pattern-grid-cells.json gained a positionally-aligned glyphs[] array so the glyph-to-slug map has one source of truth.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs#580 pool, claimed via a timestamped comment on #716 (no earlier claim found). Charter check: cell conformance, mode clear, door non-normative -- the rule to enforce was already fully specified in the issue and the Protocol's own land-stage aiGuidance; the one design choice needing judgment (extending pattern-grid-cells.json with glyphs[] rather than hardcoding a glyph map inside the check) follows this repo's existing one-source-of-truth discipline (srs#462). Proved red-then-green via four new tests/guards/run.mjs cases. Ran the finished check over the last 20 merged srs PR bodies (fetched via the GitHub REST API): 11 of 20 would fail today, none retrofitted -- see the linked finding. PR srs#722 opened with gate:auto-merge armed (mode clear, door non-normative); both required gates (validate-all, check-release-drift) are currently red for a pre-existing, already-documented reason (the stale versioning-cell-allowlist.json entry for srs/package/metamodel/fields/value_range.json) unrelated to this change, independently reproduced by four other sessions today.
